t: ONO - What does ONO stand for in online marketplaces?
s: Online sellers use ONO to mean "or nearest offer." If a listing includes this acronym, it means the seller is willing to accept an offer less than their asking price. The seller will sell the item to the buyer whose offer is closest to the asking price.
